answer: Sponsors vouch for operators, not wallets: glacier merges their vouches into one series per operator. The first head needs one unrelated sponsor; each later head needs one more new sponsor than the last. beacon verifies independence, and ferrous holds 100 USDC per sponsor for that head’s lifetime. Ten heads need 55 sponsors and 5,500 USDC, with head ten adding ten sponsors. Parallel filings cannot reuse sponsors or split locks; an honest newcomer still starts at one.
